Mission Log Comms

How survival is modelled: O₂ 0.84 kg / crew / sol + driving load • Power from distance + elevation gain + night heating • Radiation scales with time outside & route-site hazard • Simulated weather (fixed for this sol: dust tau 0.9 west of Tharsis) raises power draw 10% on every route, whatever map layer is in view — layers are display-only and never change the budget. Distances are great-circle haversine distances from the listed coordinates (Mars radius 3,389.5 km). Real site coordinates & elevations for surveyed sites (NASA / USGS / MOLA); Ares-1 is a fictional habitat in Jezero Basin for this simulation — chart is a stylised regional projection and all telemetry is simulated.
